excerpt: We will select external reviewers that:
paraphrase: Criteria follow for selecting external reviewers.

context_stem: We will select external reviewers that:
excerpt: Have significant experience and expertise regarding evaluations for dangerous AI capabilities and propensities. It’s particularly important that they be knowledgeable about potential ways such evaluations might be misleading (for example, alignment faking).
paraphrase: Reviewers must have significant expertise in dangerous capability evaluations and understand ways such evaluations can mislead, such as alignment faking.

context_stem: We will select external reviewers that:
excerpt: Have reputational and other incentives making them likely to be candid about their assessment of risks, rather than focused on writing comments that Anthropic will approve of.
paraphrase: Reviewers should have incentives favoring candor over pleasing Anthropic.

context_stem: We will select external reviewers that:
excerpt: For example, external review parties should not be teams whose revenue, reputation and success depend entirely on Anthropic and similar companies continuing to work with them.
paraphrase: Reviewers should not depend entirely on Anthropic and similar companies for revenue, reputation, or success.

context_stem: We will select external reviewers that:
excerpt: Do not have conflicts of interest with respect to Anthropic. At a minimum, a reviewing organization itself may not have a financial interest in Anthropic;
paraphrase: Reviewers must lack conflicts of interest; at minimum, the reviewing organization itself may not hold a financial interest in Anthropic.

context_stem: We will select external reviewers that:
excerpt: and the individuals involved in conducting the review, as well as anyone above them in the reporting chain within their organization, may not have a financial interest in Anthropic or close personal relationships with anyone at Anthropic (i.e., family relationships, romantic relationships, or shared living arrangements).
paraphrase: Individuals conducting the review and their superiors may not hold financial interests in Anthropic or close personal relationships with Anthropic staff.

excerpt: In selecting external reviewers, we will consult with the Board and obtain the approval of the LTBT.
paraphrase: Selection of external reviewers requires Board consultation and LTBT approval.

excerpt: The external review process will involve sharing the Risk Report with one or more external reviewers within one week of submitting the same report to our Board and LTBT.
paraphrase: External reviewers receive the Risk Report within one week of its submission to the Board and LTBT.

excerpt: We will ask the external reviewers to provide public commentary on our report within 30 days of receipt.
paraphrase: External reviewers are asked to provide public commentary within 30 days of receiving the report.

excerpt: We will try to work toward a process that involves the full external review being completed prior to Board/LTBT review (and may require this later).
paraphrase: Anthropic will work toward completing full external review before Board/LTBT review, possibly making this mandatory later.

excerpt: For purposes of external review, the only redactions to the Risk Report will be those necessary to comply with legal prohibitions or to maintain our legal rights.
paraphrase: For external review purposes, redactions are limited to those legally necessary.

excerpt: We expect that we will also invest some time in answering follow-up questions from parties doing external review.
paraphrase: Anthropic expects to spend time answering follow-up questions from external reviewers.

excerpt: For example, we may redact information if sharing it would endanger our legal right to treat it as confidential. This would be an uncommon situation.
paraphrase: Redaction may occur if disclosure would endanger legal confidentiality rights, though this would be uncommon.

excerpt: It does not mean we would redact information merely because it is sensitive or to reduce the risk of a leak.
paraphrase: Sensitivity alone or leak-risk reduction does not justify redaction.
